proposed_scope.goal: Do not repeat unchanged public-source audits; surface only NEW/CHANGED/STALE candidates.

SEALED protected data + access request => DENY

Owner sees exceptions and decisions, not routing/SHA/repeated-source clerical work.
Evidence before real worker autonomy; no external/provider side effects.
